purpose: Candidate-independent RT-focused structural reference panel for orthogonal comparison of the 43 frozen R5 P1 full-coordinate structures.
weak_hit_rule: Foldseek hit passing the frozen E-value threshold but not strong/suggestive structural criteria
claim_boundary: R5B is post-discovery protein interpretation only. An RT-panel structural match is evidence of fold compatibility, not proof of reverse-transcriptase activity or ART identity. No-hit remains unresolved, not negative.
